title: Zero Crossings on the Accuracy-Smoothness Frontier: Maximal Monotone and Minimal Inflection Non Stationary Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2610.41963v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Smooth Sign Accuracy (SSA) framework resolves the smoothness--accuracy dilemma for stationary predictors by balancing mean squared error (MSE) against the frequency of sign changes. We generalize it to non-stationary integrated processes (I-SSA), deriving MSE-optimal predictors constrained by the expected duration between turning points (I(1)) or inflection points (I(2)). The resulting maximal-monotone and minimal-inflection predictors, filters, and smoothers customize classic benchmarks along a new efficient Accuracy--Smoothness (AS) frontier. Tracking the identity (the original data) along this frontier defines the \emph{I-SSA trend}, a novel smoothing concept that, unlike classical filters, imposes no artificial structure on the data-generating process and is directly interpretable through explicit control of turning- or inflection-point frequency. translated_abstract: 平滑符号精度框架通过在均方误差（MSE）与符号变化频率之间进行权衡，解决了平稳预测器的平滑度-精度两难问题。我们将其推广到非平稳单整过程（I-SSA），在转折点（I(1)）或拐点（I(2)）之间期望持续时间的约束下，推导出MSE最优的预测器。由此得到的极大单调与极小拐点预测器、滤波器和平滑器，沿着一条新的高效精度-平滑（AS）边界对经典基准方法进行了定制。沿此边界追踪恒等映射（即原始数据）定义了I-SSA趋势，这是一种新颖的平滑概念，与经典滤波器不同，它不对数据生成过程施加任何人为结构，并且可以通过显式控制转折点或拐点的频率来直接解释。该优化问题是一个二次约束二次规划（QCQP），可简化为……
tldr: 该论文将平滑符号精度（SSA）框架推广至非平稳单整过程，提出极大单调与极小拐点预测器，并由此定义了I-SSA趋势这一新平滑概念，通过显式控制转折点/拐点频率在新的精度-平滑度有效边界上定制经典滤波器，且无需对数据生成过程施加人为结构假设。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes the Smooth Sign Accuracy framework to non-stationary integrated processes (I-SSA), deriving maximal-monotone and minimal-inflection predictors that trace a new accuracy-smoothness frontier and define the I-SSA trend, a novel smoothing concept directly interpretable through explicit control of turning- or inflection-point frequency without imposing artificial structure on the data-generating process.
